A new identity spends its first 6 epochs on probation, during which its attestations count for 38% of full weight. Running a farm hence buys partial influence at full price for each extra identity, and the discount only arrives after the operator has already paid the bond. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
